top_signals.title: Appointment of Chair and Deputy Chair of the Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC)
top_signals.summary: Following an external recruitment process, the Bank of England (the Bank) has appointed Nicholas Segal as Chair of its Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC), and Peter King as Deputy Chair, with effect from 1 August 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Cronos blockchain restarts after $74 million Tectonic exploit
top_signals.summary: The Cronos blockchain network has resumed trading activity after a price-manipulation attack on the Tectonic cryptocurrency lending platform allowed an attacker to borrow $74 million. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Ghost of Multibillion-Dollar Subsidy Stalks Key African Election
top_signals.summary: A multibillion-dollar fuel subsidy that kept Nigerian pump prices low for decades has emerged as a central battleground ahead of January’s presidential elections.

top_signals.title: Chinese Fire Ant hackers turn Cisco routers into spying platforms
top_signals.summary: The researchers discovered Fire Ant's new tactic after finding an active GRE (Generic Routing Encapsulation) tunnel interface on a Cisco IOS XR router that could not be explained by a running configuration or commit history. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Berlin says it won’t pay ransom after hackers steal government data
top_signals.summary: Governing Mayor Kai Wegner said that Berlin had received an extortion demand following the cyberattack, which was discovered in mid-August.
